identificationModule.briefTitle: Creon in HIV Patients With Steatorrhea
identificationModule.officialTitle: Double-blind, Cross-over, Randomized, Placebo-controlled, Multi-center Study to Investigate the Effect of Creon®25 000 on the Coefficient of Fat Absorption of HIV-infected Patients

statusModule.whyStopped: Discontinued prematurely due to low enrollment

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study investigates the effect of pancreatic enzymes on steatorrhea in HIV patients.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Normalization (yes, no) of stool fat excretion, i.e. < 7 g/day
Response (yes, no) with respect to stool fat excretion, i.e. improvement in stool fat excretion as compared to baseline
